title: Voting agreements.
bodyText:
(a) Two or more shareholders may provide for the manner in which they will vote their shares by signing an agreement for that purpose. A voting agreement created under this section is not subject to section 414-161.

(b) A voting agreement created under this section is specifically enforceable.
bodyHtml:
[§414-162]  Voting agreements.  (a)  Two or more shareholders may provide for the manner in which they will vote their shares by signing an agreement for that purpose.  A voting agreement created under this section is not subject to section 414-161.

     (b)  A voting agreement created under this section is specifically enforceable. [L 2000, c 244, pt of §1]
